topic: Choose a dessert for Sunday dinner

scenario.topic: Choose a dessert for Sunday dinner
scenario.opening_question: When picking a dessert for Sunday dinner, what matters most to you—richness, prep time, portion size, or something lighter and healthier?

options.name: Classic New York Cheesecake
options.upside: Rich, creamy texture with a crowd-pleasing flavor.
options.tradeoff: Long baking and chilling time required.
options.concern: High in calories and quite heavy after a big meal.
options.best_for: Those prioritizing indulgence and classic dessert appeal.

options.name: Lemon Blueberry Panna Cotta
options.upside: Light, refreshing, and tangy with fresh fruit topping.
options.tradeoff: Needs refrigeration for several hours before serving.
options.concern: Smaller portion size might not satisfy bigger appetites.
options.best_for: Those wanting a lighter, fruit-forward dessert.

options.name: Warm Chocolate Lava Cakes
options.upside: Quick to make with a gooey, decadent chocolate center.
options.tradeoff: Limited to only two servings, no leftovers.
options.concern: Very rich and heavy, might be too much after dinner.
options.best_for: Those who want fast, intense chocolate indulgence.

options.name: Fresh Fruit Salad with Honey Yogurt
options.upside: Quick, healthy, and refreshing with natural sweetness.
options.tradeoff: Less indulgent and might feel too light after a big meal.
options.concern: Some fruits may not be as sweet or flavorful this season.
options.best_for: Those prioritizing health and ease of preparation.

shared_context: There are exactly 2 people deciding together.
The dessert will be served after a hearty Sunday roast dinner.
The total budget for dessert ingredients is around $15.

personas.name: Hana
personas.background: I love quick desserts that deliver intense flavor because I often have limited time to prepare after dinner.
personas.private_goal: I want the group to choose a dessert that is fast to make yet indulgent and satisfying.

personas.name: Thea
personas.background: I prefer classic, well-loved desserts that feel special for family dinners and can serve everyone adequately.
personas.private_goal: I want the group to select a dessert that offers a rich, creamy experience and enough servings for all guests.
